statement: Pinned Linux and SDL DS4 Bluetooth consumers recognize 10-byte minimal input 0x01 and 78-byte full input 0x11. Full 0x11 has two transport-prefix bytes ahead of 32-byte common input state, up to four nine-byte touch history entries, and a final little-endian CRC32 seeded with HID input header 0xA1; Linux rejects invalid input CRC, whereas SDL conditionally tolerates invalid CRC and recognizes other enhanced IDs in the 0x11-0x19 range.
